A '''Sith guard''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[3960 BBY]]. Following the [[Assassination attempt in the Korsinata|assassination attempt]] on [[Grand Lord]] [[Lillia Venn]], the guard watched the former [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Candra Kitai]], who had been made a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]. As Kitai shoveled manure at [[the zoo]], Kitai's daughter [[Orielle Kitai]] jumped from the roof of the facility onto the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], knocking him unconscious. She then dragged him into a nearby stall and stole his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
